name: sf-8-0-site-quality-tools
description: Dev-only Node dependencies for the site quality tools: axe-core for tools/check_site_quality.py, and mermaid for tools/validate_mermaid.py. The mermaid version here is the contract: it must match the version the built site loads (docs/assets/mermaid.min.js, vendored by tools/vendor_mermaid.py) so a diagram that passes validation is the same diagram a visitor renders.
